description:
Lists the past estimates on your account, newest first. Use this when the user wants to find an earlier estimate ("what did I estimate last week?") or has lost an estimate_id.

Returns estimates, each with estimate_id, created_at, question, unit, target_horizon, point_estimate, estimation_interval, distribution_family and status; and next_offset, the offset of the next page, or null on the last page. For an estimate's full detail, pass its estimate_id to get_estimate_result.

Estimates made without an account cannot be listed. To get an account, call POST https://fermi.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts (it returns an api_key once; a new account starts with 3 credits), or sign in through your connector. If you cannot make HTTP requests, ask the user to do one of these.

Cost: free, but account only: without an account the call is refused with a sign-in requirement.

api_key.description: Your Fermi API key. Required unless your connector is signed in. Get one with POST https://fermi.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts.
api_key.title: Api Key

limit.description: How many estimates to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: How many of the newest estimates to skip, for paging: pass the previous page's next_offset. Default 0.
offset.title: Offset

name: list_my_estimates

billing.description: Who this call was billed to and what is left. Present on every Fermi result.

account_id.description: Account id; null without an account.

account_status.description: "created" if this call created the account, otherwise "matched"; null without an account.

anonymous_estimates_remaining_today.description: Free tier-1 estimates left today without an account; null for an account.

anonymous_quota_resets_at.description: When the free allowance resets (next 00:00 UTC, ISO 8601).

auth_source.description: How you were recognised: "bearer" (signed-in connector or token), "api_key" (the argument) or "anonymous".

charged_to.description: What this call drew on: the free daily allowance, account credits, or "none" (free calls).

credit_balance.description: Credits left on the account; null without an account.

is_unlimited.description: True for an internal account that is never charged.

estimation_interval.description: The range that should contain the true value with probability coverage_probability. For a probability question, both ends are probabilities between 0 and 1.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page.

title: List your past estimates (account only)
